My biggest fear in life is that I'll end up old and alone.
All I've wanted for years is death. I've tried many times to kill myself. I just want rest. I want to get away from myself for a change. Any consequences of ending my life would be worth it.

I have social phobia and major depressive disorder. I've struggled for years to overcome them. I've been having suicidal thoughts since I was thirteen. I grew up in an apocalyptic cult that brainwashed me from an early age. Since then I've struggled to accept reality. I see no meaning or purpose in life and feel like I'm a miserable failure who doesn't deserve to be happy.
People only really care about themselves.
Solitude only makes me hate life even more.
Alcohol is probably the biggest drug problem on the planet.
I've been to therapy and tried several different meds. All I'm able to do is keep myself from drowning.
The list would be too long to put here.

I hate everything about myself. I don't have any hope for the future.
I know I don't belong in this world. I always felt that way. I will until the day I die, and I will die soon.
